I love this game. I really do. The story that it told when I first started playing the game was truly wonderful. It was a game about how love and compassion can beat out the cynicism of the world that tries to surround us and leave us to doom and gloom. It was a story about how you are always able to be the person that you choose to be, not who you were made to be, nor who you were built to be. 

But the narrative that this game is now, it's not that anymore. The protoframes came out and the story went from what it was above to focusing on more protoframes. We were told we weren't going to get more protoframes after Warframe 1999 (came out in December 2024) and Techrot Encore (March 2025). There were 10 protoframes at the time. At time of writing, there are another 5 now, 3 for the devil's triad, a story beat that's very referential to Catholocism. I'm not opposed to that if we own up to it and acknowledge it. You can't have a devil warframe named Uriel or a protoframe who is a priest or a nun and not expect people to think of Catholicism. And 2 more added in this latest update, with no explanation on where they come from, they just appear! And the Garuda protoframe is sexually harassing the stalker's kid? 

The newest update was just, uninteresting. It had characters from the future look at the camera and say "it doesn't matter how we're here, what matters is we ARE here." It had Hunhow sacrifice his memories suddenly to provide Stalker the chance to be a father? The gameplay is fire, Sirius & Orion look great to play and seem really fun. The narrative is just... baffling. 

I can't recommend this game anymore if you are a person who cares about story. If you're a person who wants consistency from writers, you won't get that here. We've retconned the history of entire factions and quietly updated quest dialogue to match that. The infestation, originally a bioweapon made by the Orokin, are now an eldritch horror that came from space.

If you only care about the gameplay, sure it's a fun game. The game's getting a lot better in that regard under Rebecca Ford's creative vision, a lot of really good QOL has been added. The game is being updated and made slightly more current. It's grindy, it expects a lot of time, but the gameplay is unlike any other. 

But the gameplay feels meaningless when the narrative is bafflingly bad and inconsistent. I've played this game for almost 9 years, I love it. I hate it. I hope things change.

Wowza.
That's all I've got to say on this one.
